display.summary: Patch beta: forms save once, personal column eye controls, faster PDF opening and backup browsing, Composer wrapper 6, an Updates card that settles and shows release notes, and ScanLink checks before every scan.
highlights: Save changes in the unsaved-changes prompt submits the form once instead of twice.
Arrange columns shows an eye on each header to show or hide it; the inspector is gone.
The PDF viewer downloads a file once, and reopening a record revalidates instead of downloading it again.
The backup viewer shows loading progress, uses faster password derivation and cached deep pages, and keeps your current view when older requests finish.
New projects get Composer wrapper 6: ./start.sh update refreshes the deployer first, and ./start.sh update self accepts -f/-d anywhere.
The Updates card stops spinning when a check ends, shows each release's own notes, and reloads after Finish so the page matches the new release.
The update log no longer shows DEBUG lines from the project's own logging.
ScanLink re-checks its connection before every scan, so a lost HTTPS link falls back to HTTP instead of failing the scan.
